content.intro: In this lesson, you will study array utility methods with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you organize indexed data and avoid incorrect indexes or accidental sharing when copying arrays. In this lesson, focus on arrays.tostring() and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: String values are immutable sequences of text. Use value equality for text content, understand Unicode code points for international text, and prefer StringBuilder for repeated concatenation in loops. The important habit is to make the assumptions explicit and use the code example as a small experiment.
